segments.transcript: [Residential address redacted], reference to a missing-person report from the east side. A unit acknowledges the call.

segments.timingBasis: PLUNDER reports approximately 11:50 p.m. from CrimeRadar but says the Broadcastify placement may be hours later
segments.title: A vehicle-key dispute is reported; case connection is unconfirmed
segments.transcriptConfidence: High for the audible call; low for its connection to Nolan
segments.transcript: [Residential address redacted]. RP said they were trying to get keys to a vehicle, but a male is refusing to give them to her and her daughter. Dispatch could hear them yelling in the background. RP did say that it is almost physical, but not physical yet.

segments.title: Unit says it is dealing with a potential missing person
segments.transcriptConfidence: High for the quoted sentence; low for attribution to Nolan's case
segments.transcript: 32, finish up with whatever you got and get down here. Currently dealing with a potential missing person. A follow-up asks whether the unit has all the information from a separate 10-50 call.

segments.title: Unit is directed to meet Nolan's mother for a missing-person report
segments.transcriptConfidence: High for the central dispatch; the automated draft initially misrecognized the name and island
segments.transcript: Per 19, can you meet the RP at the McDonald's in front of the Ocean Springs Walmart? She's going to be in a white Volkswagen Atlas. [She needs to] report her 18-year-old son, Nolan Wells, missing, last seen at 3 on Horn Island.

segments.title: Nolan remains missing; DMR, Coast Guard, and vehicle retrieval are discussed
segments.transcriptConfidence: High for the principal exchange; the final vehicle description contains an unclear word
segments.transcript: Has the missing person been recovered? Negative. Copy. PD, call County Dispatch and [ask whether] we have further information that DMR and the Coast Guard are actively searching. The parents came and picked up the vehicle [at] the house that he spent the night at [unclear final word].

segments.title: Boat-related disturbance is linked on air to a missing juvenile
segments.transcriptConfidence: High for the central exchange; the focused clip begins after an earlier residential address
segments.transcript: What exactly is going on with this call? The people from the Signal 80 from earlier tonight are harassing these people on the boat. They believe that they have connections to this missing juvenile.

segments.title: Information that could assist the county and DMR is discussed
segments.transcriptConfidence: Moderate; the question is clear enough to identify county/DMR assistance, while the response is compressed
segments.transcript: [Have] they provided you with new information that could assist the county and DMR in this? The response is radio-compressed and remains unclear.

segments.transcriptConfidence: High for the status; unit numbers are radio-compressed
segments.transcript: [121], Jackson. [121], go ahead. Show myself and [50] on the water. 10-4.

segments.transcript: 149. Go ahead. Hey, just make sure y'all update with dispatch on the boat and who's in the boat with you there.

segments.transcriptConfidence: High

segments.transcriptConfidence: High

segments.title: Boat units receive a photo and a reported 4:00–4:30 sighting
segments.transcriptConfidence: High for the central relay; one word describing the source of the report is unclear
segments.transcript: Any of y'all boat units, I just sent y'all a picture. That was apparently sent to the mother. He was seen around that location by somebody that [knew/noticed] him about 4:30. The boat that he was supposedly on when he arrived, they left about 3, so you may want to check that photo. Later: I spoke to one person there that said at 4 o'clock yesterday he was on the south side by a boat that did not leave with them.

segments.title: Reported 4:00–4:30 Dog Keys Pass sighting is added to the call
segments.transcriptConfidence: High
segments.transcript: If you will, just add to that missing-person call: someone that knows him saw him around 4 o'clock, 4 to 4:30, near Dog Key Pass on Horn Island. They actually spoke to him as well.

segments.title: Pascagoula police are reported aware of a missing person
segments.transcriptConfidence: High for the short statement; the first word is slightly compressed
segments.transcript: [Pascagoula] PD is also aware of a missing person. 10-4.

segments.title: Island personnel and an east-tip approach are discussed
segments.transcriptConfidence: Moderate; radio compression obscures several agency and location words
segments.transcript: [The last-seen area is] out here on the island that we need to speak with. We've got the [park] rangers out on the island. [DMR]'s out here. I've already let her know you're going to be flying. Roger that. We're approaching the [east tip] at this point.

segments.title: Units warned about boats around the reported missing area
segments.transcriptConfidence: High for the central warning
segments.transcript: Keep in mind there are boats tied up all up and around this area where he was missing when you come through. Copy that.

segments.title: Patrol units asked to check Lake Mars and boat launches
segments.transcriptConfidence: High for the central request; follow-up partly unclear
segments.transcript: Can we have the patrol units, particularly west side, like Lake Mars and areas like that, just to check boat launches, see if maybe he was taken back and dropped off in that area, kind of ride through Lake Mars and other areas, looking for him. A follow-up again asks for the area to be checked if he received a ride back; several words are unclear.

segments.title: Point, dock, and island search areas discussed
segments.transcriptConfidence: Moderate; several place-name and radio-code words remain unclear
segments.transcript: Can you go look around the Point area, maybe on the rocks, near the grass, anything that you can find over there, and look for [signal 80 subject] from Horn Island. They are not finding anything on the island. They want to take the Point area, all those dock areas. Later: We're going to actually move on down the island, because everything is clear from where we've been.

segments.title: Search description mentions black swimming shorts
segments.transcriptConfidence: Moderate; one phrase remains unclear
segments.transcript: So are y'all looking for a light-skinned Black male, [unclear], wearing black swimming shorts?

segments.title: Boat-ramp checks and nearby jurisdictions reported
segments.transcriptConfidence: High for the overall status; two words remain unclear
segments.transcript: A lot of our units checked the boat ramps in our area, and Pascagoula checked—there's negative contact [with the male] at any of the boat ramps or piers. I also contacted Biloxi as well. They should be calling back shortly. They're checking their boat [ramps/routes] as well.

segments.title: Aerial unit reports leaving the islands after negative contact
segments.transcriptConfidence: High for the negative-contact report; destination wording is partly unclear
segments.transcript: We're leaving the islands. It was negative contact, so [negative for] anything from the air. We're headed back to [unclear]. 10-4.

segments.transcriptConfidence: High for the Coast Guard request; the frequency reply and case linkage require review
segments.transcript: Coast Guard is asking which frequency you're on, because they would like to communicate with you. The responding unit identifies a frequency, but the exact numbers are unclear in the available recording.

segments.transcriptConfidence: High for the negative status; the first Coast Guard sentence is partly unclear
segments.transcript: If you will, [Coast Guard—advise them we're moving toward] the mainland. Anything we need to check again? Negative on everything. Just covering all of our bases. We didn't see anything that [needs] to be checked.

segments.transcriptConfidence: High for the audible sentence
segments.transcript: You have Captain Craig here at 21? I believe it's going to be in reference to that missing person that they're all looking for. 10-4.
